aaos_ankle_conditioning.title: Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program
aaos_ankle_conditioning.reason: Documents band-resisted dorsiflexion and identifies anterior tibialis; supports exercise selection, not a measured set-credit fraction.

nhs_toe_raise.title: Strength and balance exercise programme for falls prevention
nhs_toe_raise.reason: Documents lifting the forefoot while retaining heel contact; supports the bodyweight toe-raise movement.

nhs_seated_toe_raise.title: Lower limb strengthening activities
nhs_seated_toe_raise.reason: Documents seated toe lifts with heels down; supports toe-raise terminology and accessible progression.

nhs_strength_balance_toe_raise.title: Strength and balance exercises
nhs_strength_balance_toe_raise.reason: Documents toe raises; corroborates bodyweight dorsiflexion as a distinct exercise from calf raises.

tib_bar_manufacturer.title: Tib Bar – Tibialis Trainer
tib_bar_manufacturer.reason: Documents bilateral and unilateral tib-bar equipment and seated dorsiflexion technique only; commercial injury-prevention claims are not adopted.

osu_iliopsoas_progression.title: Gluteus Medius Repair: Appendix A, Psoas Progression
osu_iliopsoas_progression.reason: Documents supine short-lever, seated, and standing resisted hip flexion; supports distinct positions, not transfer of postoperative dosage to general training.

cuh_hip_flexion.title: Hip strengthening exercises
cuh_hip_flexion.reason: Documents supported standing hip flexion with the knee bent and a hold; supports the standing hip-flexion hold.

uw_seated_hip_flexion.title: Physical Therapy Before and After Your ACL Surgery: Seated Hip Flexion
uw_seated_hip_flexion.reason: Documents seated bent-knee hip flexion as distinct from a straight-leg raise; supports exercise identity only.

nhs_resisted_neck_rotation.title: Neck pain: Resisted neck exercises
nhs_resisted_neck_rotation.reason: Documents hand-resisted cervical rotation, flexion and side flexion; rotation is a distinct addition, while existing flexion/side records retain their IDs.

aaos_rotator_cuff_conditioning.title: Rotator Cuff and Shoulder Conditioning Program
aaos_rotator_cuff_conditioning.reason: Documents 90-degree-abducted external rotation, supine rotation and side-lying internal/external rotation. Existing side-lying external rotation is retained with aliases.

andersson_hip_flexor_emg_1997.title: Abdominal and hip flexor muscle activation during various training exercises
andersson_hip_flexor_emg_1997.reason: Fine-wire iliacus evidence supports hip-flexor involvement during hip-flexion sit-ups and leg lifts, without extending the claim to every curl-up.

juker_psoas_emg_1998.title: Quantitative intramuscular myoelectric activity of lumbar portions of psoas and the abdominal wall during a wide variety of tasks
juker_psoas_emg_1998.reason: Sit-ups recruited psoas more than curl-ups. Supports exact full-sit-up indirect hip-flexor roles, not a measured 0.5 hypertrophy equivalence or general lifting credit.

reinold_supraspinatus_emg_2007.title: Electromyographic analysis of the supraspinatus and deltoid muscles during 3 common rehabilitation exercises
reinold_supraspinatus_emg_2007.reason: Fine-wire EMG supports supraspinatus involvement in full-can scaption and prone horizontal abduction with external rotation. The incline reverse-fly mapping is a medium-confidence extrapolation; 0.5 remains the DB++ accounting convention.

kim_split_squat_ankle_emg_2017.title: Comparison of Activities of Tibialis Anterior, Peroneus Longus, and Tibialis Posterior Muscles according to Lunge Squats and Bulgarian Split Squats in a Healthy Population
kim_split_squat_ankle_emg_2017.reason: Measures ankle-stability activation during held squat postures; insufficient to assign 0.5 tibialis sets to ordinary squats or lunges.

neck_shrug_training_1997.title: Effects of neck muscle training and detraining on neck muscle strength
neck_shrug_training_1997.reason: Narrow-grip shrug intervention suggests neck-strength transfer in a specific protocol; does not establish an independent neck hypertrophy dose for all shrug variants, so no blanket 0.5 credit is awarded.

neck_rotation.summary: Hand-resisted cervical rotation is documented by NHS exercise guidance; direct neck credit follows the DB++ model.

sit_up_hip_flexor_contribution.summary: Exact full sit-up records include indirect hip-flexor credit based on iliacus/psoas studies. Curl-ups are excluded. The 0.5 fraction is an accounting convention, not a study-derived dose equivalence.

scaption_cuff_contribution.summary: Full-can scapular-plane elevation recruits supraspinatus. DB++ conservatively records indirect cuff credit alongside deltoid/trapezius roles, without claiming EMG establishes 0.5 hypertrophy sets.

reverse_fly_external_rotation_cuff_contr.summary: Prone full-can horizontal-abduction evidence supports cuff involvement. Transfer to the catalog incline reverse fly with external rotation is uncertain and remains medium confidence; ordinary reverse flyes are unchanged.
